name: client-support-ratings-notifications-preferences
executionConcern: customer support, ratings, notifications, preferences and recovery interactions
objective: Close customer support conversations, order rescue readback, rating eligibility/submission, notifications/deep links and preference mutations with owner-scoped authorization, retry-safe commands and canonical reload.
truthOwner: DSH owns support/incident/rescue, ratings and notification preference operational truth; Notifications delivers messages but does not replace DSH state.

tasks.objective: Close customer support, rating and notification interaction loops
tasks.currentProblem: Operational tests verify failure-safe support navigation and notification reload markers, while Product Truth requires actor-owned tickets, hidden internal notes and governed rescue; runtime isolation, idempotency and deep-link authorization remain unproven.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace support/rating/notification/preference commands to contracts, handlers and persistence; fix ownership, expected-state/idempotency, internal-note redaction, post-mutation reload and deep-link object authorization.
tasks.targetState: Client can access only owned support/rating/order notification objects, mutations are retry-safe, internal/operator data never leaks and every success reloads canonical state.
tasks.action: Fix DSH owner/state-machine issues first, then shared controllers and client screens; include only partner/captain/operator slices necessary for the same ticket/order consequence.
mustNotChange: Do not expose internal operator notes.
Do not allow another actor's ticket/order/rating through guessed IDs or deep links.
Do not use local-only rescue/support status.
Do not mutate WLT financial truth from support/rescue.
acceptanceCriteria: Support access is owner-scoped and internal notes are absent from client responses.
Duplicate message/rating/preference actions do not create duplicate effects.
Notification mutations reload canonical state and deep links re-authorize target objects.
Order rescue outcomes appear through canonical order/support readback without local financial mutation.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused implementation commit or roll forward at the canonical owner while preserving audit/data evidence; never restore a parallel truth source.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U006 implementation commit after owner correction, directly affected consumer migration, cleanup and all linked checks.
